title: JS: EventSource Contact subscription + handleStateEvent Contact branch
description:
Add Contact type to EventSource subscription and handle Contact state changes in handleStateEvent.

What: Two small changes to existing JS functions: (1) subscribe to Contact events, (2) on Contact state change fetch updated contacts and re-render.

Algorithm:
1. In startEventSource() (or buildEventsUrl call site), change the types string from 'Message,Chat' to 'Message,Chat,Contact'.
2. In handleStateEvent(event), add a Contact branch alongside the existing Message and Chat branches:
   a. Extract changed.Contact (new state token) from the event data.
   b. Maintain a module-level contactState variable (initialized to null; set by fetchContacts).
   c. If changed.Contact is present AND contactState is not null:
      - Call callJmap with Contact/changes { accountId, sinceState: contactState }.
      - Parse the /changes result: update contactState to newState.
      - If created.length > 0 or updated.length > 0 or destroyed.length > 0:
        - Call fetchContacts() to get updated list.
        - Call renderContactList([...contacts.values()]).
      - If cannotCalculateChanges: call fetchContacts() and renderContactList.
   d. If changed.Contact present AND contactState is null: set contactState = changed.Contact (sync token without fetching delta).
3. In fetchContacts(), after populating contacts map, set contactState = result.state (or result.queryState from Contact/query, whichever is returned).

Defensive programming rules:
- contactState must never be used as a DOM value or rendered
- On Contact/changes error, log to console and skip re-render (non-fatal, will resync on next event)
- Guard: if fetchContacts is already in-flight, skip redundant fetch

Tests (independent oracle: EventSource state event JSON spec):
- Test 1: fire a synthetic state event with changed.Contact; assert Contact/changes is called with correct sinceState.
- Test 2: Contact/changes returns created=['uid-bob']; assert fetchContacts() is called.
- Test 3: cannotCalculateChanges=true; assert fetchContacts() is called.
- Test 4: event has no changed.Contact; assert no Contact/changes call made.
